data.title: Team Leader
data.description:
Team Leader

Lotus Care provides a range of respite, residential and support services to Children & Adults with intellectual disabilities in a homely and comfortable community setting. We aim to empower people with the necessary skills to live full and satisfying lives as equal citizens of their local communities.


Do to company expansions and recent promotions we are now seeking a Team Leader for on of our Laois locations.


Role Overview

Reporting to: Person in Charge

Job Type: Full-Time, Monday to Friday (some on-call as required)

Working Week: 40 hours a week

Location of Work: Borris-in-Ossory


What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary
  • Employee of the Month Scheme
  • Annual bonus
  • EAP Scheme
  • Refer a Friend Scheme
  • Company events
  • On-going mentoring and support
  • CPD support


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead and support staff in delivering high-quality services for individuals with intellectual disabilities.
  • Oversee and implement each person’s Personal Plan through regular reviews.
  • Liaise with families, schools, and day programme staff to ensure continuity of support.
  • Support the PIC in ensuring compliance with HIQA regulations and standards.
  • Ensure delivery of appropriate, person-centred care and support for daily living activities.
  • Manage key operational areas including safety, risk, finances, transport, and rosters.
  • Provide leadership, supervision, and performance management for assigned staff.
  • Support staff development through training, personal development planning, and reviews.
  • Keep records and databases up to date, including monitoring and auditing processes.
  • Act as a point of contact for the service, addressing queries professionally and promptly.


Essential Requirements

  • Minimum of a Level 7 degree in Social Care or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in the ID sector, preferably in a management/supervisory role
  • CORU registered (or in the process)
  • Working knowledge of HIQA standards and regulations
  • Garda Vetting/Police Clearance

data.title: Social Care Assistant
data.description:
Social Care Assistant – Full Time (Permanent)


Are you fed up with traveling from client to client?

Do you enjoy supporting vulnerable children and young adults?

Do you spend a lot of your working day dealing with traffic?

Do your expenses not cover the wear and tear of your own personal car?


Here at Lotus Care we are offering real, full-time contracts, a 42hr week, at the same location.


Benefits  

  • One set work location and guaranteed hours
  • Competitive premiums for unsocial hours
  • Ongoing mentoring and support
  • Refer a Friend Scheme
  • Employee of the Month Scheme
  • Company events
  • Free onsite parking
  • CPD support


Role Overview

  •  Reporting to: Person in Charge
  •  Contract Type: Full-time
  •  Working Week: Average of 42 hours a week,
  • Location of Work: Kildare Region


Role Responsibilities

  •  Facilitate and encourage decision-making, independence, and personal development.
  •  Provide support in daily living skills, including personal hygiene, health and appearance.
  •  Work in a person-centred manner to meet individual care plans and goals.
  •  Adhere to policies and procedures, standards, regulations, and codes of practice
  •  Administer and document the dispensation of prescribed medication.
  •  Undertake key worker responsibilities, helping service owners achieve goals.
  •  Document and report incidents and complaints involving staff, service owners or visitors.
  •  Work with MDT to achieve the goals of service owners.


Essential Requirements

  •  Minimum Level 5 qualification in Social or Health Care Studies
  •  Hold a full Irish driving license (to drive a company car, when required)
  •  Prior experience in social care or healthcare desirable but not essential
  •  Working knowledge of relevant standards and regulations.
  •  Excellent English essential (verbal and written skills)
  •  Garda Vetting/Police Clearance

data.title: Residential Support Worker
data.description:
Lotus Care provides a range of respite, residential and support services to Children & Adults with intellectual disabilities in a homely and comfortable community setting. We aim to empower people with the necessary skills to live full and satisfying lives as equal citizens of their local communities. 

Lotus Care is currently recruiting for an experienced Healthcare Assistant.

 

Position Details

  • Employer: Lotus Care
  • Position: Residential Support Worker
  • Location: Clonalsee, Co. Laois
  • Hours: Average 42 hours per week (12 hour shifts, days & nights)
  • Role Type: Permanent position - expected start date August.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide high-quality, person-centred care and support to service owners.
  • Assist service owners with personal care, hygiene, feeding, and daily living activities.
  • Support the emotional, social, and physical wellbeing of service owners.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and secure environment in line with health and safety standards and individual care plans.
  • Promote and advocate for the rights, dignity, and individual needs of service owners.
  • Support participation in community and recreational activities.
  • Monitor and report safeguarding, welfare, or health concerns in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Carry out additional duties as required by management.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Minimum QQI Level 5 qualification in Healthcare Support, Social Care, or equivalent qualification.
  • Previous experience supporting children or adults with intellectual and/or physical disabilities.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Commitment to delivering high standards of care and support.


This role is also suitable for Experienced Support Workers, Assistant Support Workers, Care Workers, Healthcare Workers, High Support Specialist, Senior Support Worker, Senior Care Assistant and Care Assistants!

  • Take on Key Worker responsibilities, helping service owners reach goals
  • Maintain accurate documentation and reports
  • Work closely with the MDT to support service owners’ goals
  • Document and report incidents and complaints involving staff, service owners or visitors.
  • Day and waking night shifts required.

 

What You Need

  • Minimum Level 5 qualification in Social / Health Care Studies or relevant discipline (SCA)
  • Minimum Level 7 qualification in Social / Health Care Studies or relevant discipline
  • CORU Registered (SCW)
  • Full Irish driving licence (to drive company vehicle when required)
  • Flexibility for both Day/Night Shifts
  • Experience in social care or healthcare desirable but not essential
  • Good knowledge of relevant standards and regulations
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Garda Vetting/Police Clearance
